---
name: Canonical work item
about: One implementation or evidence owner, one measurable outcome
title: "[Area · Type] "
---

**Owner:** existing canonical source/runtime and one of Mass · Prayer · Calendar · Formation · Explore · Platform · Release

**Problem and user impact:** What breaks, is missing, or is unclear in the production app?

**Current main evidence:** Specific file/record IDs, recent merged PRs, test results and source URLs. Do not assume a previous prototype is production.

**Unique scope:** What must change? What related work already exists and must not be duplicated?

**Acceptance:** Exact source/content assertions, runnable tests, real-phone navigation if relevant, and evidence needed for publication.

**Status:** Research hold / implementation / needs independent certification / ready for release. Never equate successful CI with doctrinal/source certification.

**Out of scope:** Record deferred work and its existing canonical owner; don't create a second pipeline for it.
